baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated Form II كَذَّبَ and Form V تَوَلَّىٰ join a verdict to a bodily or social response.
baseline_models.mechanism: Declaring the claim or its bearer false licenses withdrawal from attention and compliance; the second verb enacts the first rather than merely adding another fault.

activation_trace.role: Attribution of falsehood supplies the verbal verdict that licenses disengagement.
Averting and retreating make the verdict operative as refusal of attention or compliance.

changed_reading.before: Two adjacent predicates report that he denied and then turned away.
changed_reading.after: The clause depicts one coupled refusal: he invalidates what addresses him and then embodies that judgment by withdrawing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: كَذَّبَ can activate failure to make a charge true in performance, while تَوَلَّىٰ can hold both taking charge and abandoning it.
baseline_models.mechanism: The person proves an entrusted undertaking false by not carrying it through; withdrawal can therefore be read as abdication from a charge, not only departure from a proposition.

activation_trace.role: A charge that fails because it is not carried through supplies the performative sense of falsification.
Assuming management or charge keeps live the responsibility from which the subject can defect.
Withdrawal supplies the act by which the charge is left unfulfilled.

changed_reading.before: Denial is chiefly a false judgment, followed by retreat.
changed_reading.after: Denial can also be a failed performance: he makes his own charge or undertaking false by abandoning it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two focus roots permit deception by displayed state and a directional polarity between facing and averting.
baseline_models.mechanism: A stance can falsify reality without a spoken lie, and turning away from one address necessarily redirects face, attention, or allegiance elsewhere.

activation_trace.role: A deceptive appearance supplies nonverbal falsification by the state one presents.
Turning the face or attention toward something supplies the usually unstated destination of reorientation.
Averting supplies the explicit departure pole of the same directional movement.

changed_reading.before: He rejects an assertion and leaves it.
changed_reading.after: He performs a counter-reality and reorients himself: away from the address, but implicitly toward another face, object, or allegiance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The night-cover and day-disclosure pair converts denial into a contest over visibility. Falsification tries to place a cover over what is there, and withdrawal tries to escape its address, but disclosure makes concealment a phase rather than a final condition.

activation_trace.role: Deception by displayed condition lets denial function as a covering appearance.
Retreat supplies the attempted spatial escape from what may become visible.
Darkness supplies the temporal medium in which concealment can seem stable.
An overlying cover supplies the operative image for suppression of visibility.
Daylight opening out supplies the counter-process that defeats enclosure.
Uncovering and manifestation supply the terminal exposure of what denial covered.

structural_cues: The paired oath clauses repeat إِذَا while reversing cover and disclosure.
The focus coordinates denial and withdrawal in the same order as concealment followed by movement away.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed processes of covering and disclosure plus the focus acts of falsifying and averting; I supply the arrow that denial seeks concealment and retreat seeks to evade exposure. A live alternative is that the cosmic pair frames contrast without describing the denier's causal strategy.

changed_reading.before: The subject refuses a claim and disengages from it.
changed_reading.after: The subject attempts a temporary concealment-and-escape operation inside a world whose counter-rhythm is disclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured making and a generated pair activate denial as counter-formation: it substitutes an invented account for a received differentiation, while withdrawal breaks relation to the paired order rather than merely disputing a sentence.

activation_trace.role: Assigning falsehood supplies the act of relabeling what has been presented.
Withdrawal supplies severance from the relation or order being named.
Measured proportion supplies an already articulated order against which the counter-account operates.
Inventing false speech supplies the shadow-mode of making that connects formation to falsification.
One member of the created pair supplies the first relational pole.
The other member supplies complementarity rather than an isolated unit.

structural_cues: The creation oath names a coordinated pair rather than a solitary product.
The focus also coordinates two acts, allowing an anti-pairing sequence to answer a generative pair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured creation, a male-female pair, and an invention-of-falsehood branch; I infer that false attribution behaves as a rival making and that withdrawal exits relation. The live alternative is that the pair serves only as oath evidence and does not specify the social mechanism of the focus.

changed_reading.before: Denial concerns whether an assertion is true.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, denial becomes anti-generative: it remakes the account of an articulated order and then withdraws from its relational demand.

context_deltas.mechanism: Purposeful movement plus dispersal makes withdrawal an active trajectory. The subject is not inert after denial; falsification organizes a course that increases distance and proves its charge false by where it goes.

activation_trace.role: Failure to carry a charge through supplies the evaluative test of the subject's course.
Withdrawal supplies the direction taken by the failed performance.
Intentional motion toward an object prevents the retreat from being read as mere passivity.
Dispersion supplies the divergent result of differently directed effort.
Distance between two things supplies the widening separation produced by the course.

structural_cues: The generalized plural striving precedes the two contrasted human trajectories.
The focus's coordinated perfect verbs summarize a completed orientation within that field of striving.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies purposeful movement, divergent outcomes, failed performance, and withdrawal; I infer that retreat itself is a directed striving that produces distance. A live alternative is that striving names the larger moral field while the focus merely lists its negative symptoms.

changed_reading.before: Turning away looks like stopping engagement.
changed_reading.after: Turning away is itself energetic and directional: denial becomes a counter-striving whose product is increasing separation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Giving, self-protection, enacted truthfulness, good action, and opening ease form a practical chain. Against it, focus denial is failure to realize the good in action, and withdrawal is refusal to enter the giving-protecting circuit.

activation_trace.role: A charge made false by failed execution supplies the negative counterpart to enacted truth.
Refusal of attention and compliance removes the subject from the practical chain.
Transfer to another supplies the outward act by which assent becomes material.
Placing oneself within protection supplies disciplined receptivity rather than self-exemption.
Realizing a promise in deed supplies the positive performative opposite of focus falsification.
Doing what is good supplies the quality embodied by the practical sequence.
Opening after constriction supplies the path-effect of enacted confirmation.

structural_cues: The giving and guarding verbs lead directly into confirmation and then facilitation.
The focus verb of denial repeats the negative trajectory's earlier verb, inviting practical contrast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sequence of transfer, protection, confirmation, good action, and opening; I infer that these acts make truth effective and that the focus verbs negate the whole circuit. A live alternative is that the sequence characterizes a person without redefining denial as performative failure.

changed_reading.after: He fails to make the claimed good true in conduct and exits the practices through which assent would become protective, generous, and path-opening.

context_deltas.mechanism: Withholding and claimed self-sufficiency close circulation; repeated denial gives that closure a verdict, and facilitation toward difficulty turns it into a self-reinforcing path. Accumulated wealth then cannot arrest the fall, so withdrawal is exposed as failed insulation.

activation_trace.role: Declaring the good false supplies the judgment that rationalizes closure.
Withdrawal supplies the attempt to become inaccessible to claim, need, and consequence.
Light, compliant movement supplies the feedback by which a chosen course becomes easier to continue.
Withholding supplies the material closure that precedes the repeated denial.
Claimed independence supplies the imagined reason no relation or response is needed.
The repeated attribution of falsehood explicitly binds the focus verb to this closed trajectory.
Twisting, opposition, and imposed difficulty supply the shape of the path produced by closure.
Accumulated property supplies the store expected to make the subject self-sufficient.
A fall ending in ruin supplies the event that stored wealth cannot block.

structural_cues: The two فَأَمَّا مَنْ trajectories mirror each other and repeat the facilitation formula.
The focus repeats the negative trajectory's denial verb after the warning and identifies its terminal subject.
The negated benefit of wealth interrupts the fantasy of self-sufficiency.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withholding, self-sufficiency, repeated denial, facilitated difficulty, wealth, and falling; I infer a closed-loop arrow in which refusal becomes easier and assets serve as imagined insulation. A live alternative is a judicial sequence in which facilitation is consequence rather than habit feedback.

changed_reading.before: The subject denies, withdraws, and later suffers an externally assigned result.
changed_reading.after: The subject builds a closed economy of refusal: withholding supports self-sufficiency, self-sufficiency supports denial, denial supports withdrawal, and that course becomes easy until its stored shield fails at the fall.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gentle indication toward a path makes the focus a refusal of available orientation rather than the behavior of someone left without a route. Denial rejects the map; turning away redirects attention from it.

activation_trace.role: Declaring the indication false supplies rejection of the map's reliability.
Turning attention toward an object supplies the positive directional capacity being misused.
Averting supplies the chosen direction away from the offered indication.
Gentle indication toward path and truth supplies an available orientation rather than coercion.

structural_cues: The emphatic responsibility statement places guidance before the warning and focus identification.
The directional range of the focus's second root answers the context's path image.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies available gentle indication and the focus's false attribution plus directional turning; I infer that the subject rejects and leaves an offered route. A live alternative is that the responsibility statement concerns provision in general and does not establish that this particular subject recognized the route.

changed_reading.before: The clause might describe a subject simply lacking belief or attention.
changed_reading.after: The clause describes active map-refusal: an offered direction is first discredited and then deliberately left.

context_deltas.mechanism: First-and-last totality, the return of a thing to its outcome, and the split root's image of unbroken succession make turning away paradoxically non-escapist: the act enters a sequence that carries it toward an owned end.

activation_trace.role: A course tested by whether it proves true supplies the temporal evaluation of the act.
Continuous succession supplies the chain that withdrawal inadvertently joins.
Lateness after a beginning supplies the terminal pole of the temporal field.
Beginning and precedence supply the initial pole from which the course departs.
Return to outcome supplies the arc by which an apparent exit reaches its consequence.
The non-dominant mapped root contributes succession and directly echoes the focus root's process image.

structural_cues: The first and last are jointly possessed, closing off a temporal outside.
A split mapping for the earlier temporal root reactivates the focus root without erasing the dominant mapping.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies temporal endpoints, return-to-outcome, succession, and focus withdrawal; I infer that the attempted exit initiates rather than escapes a consequential sequence. A live alternative is that the endpoint pair asserts sovereignty only, while the non-dominant root echo is lexical activation rather than syntax.

changed_reading.before: Turning away appears to leave the scene.
changed_reading.after: Turning away enters a temporal chain: what looks like exit proceeds without a gap and returns as outcome within a field containing both beginning and end.

context_deltas.mechanism: Warning offers caution at a distance; the warned fire can be perceived from afar, yet the identified subject is the one who meets its heat. Thus the focus's chosen aversion from warning reverses into proximity to what was warned.

activation_trace.role: Declaring the warning false disables its protective force for the subject.
Turning away supplies chosen distance from the warning.
Nearness without an interval supplies the reversed spatial result.
A warning that awakens caution supplies the opportunity to maintain protective distance.
Perceiving fire from afar supplies warning-distance before contact.
Pure, kindled flame supplies the concentrated object of the warning.
Meeting fire and its heat supplies forced contact after chosen aversion.
Hardship and suffering supply the condition of the subject specified by the following focus clause.

structural_cues: The warning, exclusive identification, and focus relative clause occur consecutively.
The focus clause specifies the conduct of the immediately preceding superlative subject.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies caution-awakening warning, distant visibility, flame, contact with heat, hardship, and focus aversion; I infer a spatial reversal from chosen distance to compelled nearness. A live alternative is that the nearness branch of the focus root is only a conceptual counter-image, not part of the surface verb's sense.

changed_reading.before: He turns away from a warning and is separately punished.
changed_reading.after: His distancing action is itself reversed: by denying the warning that could preserve distance, he moves from aversion to contact with the warned heat.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent relative-clause portraits invert agency and circulation. The focus subject actively turns away after denying; the contrasting subject gives wealth into circulation and is passively turned aside from danger while growing or purifying.

activation_trace.role: Failed enactment supplies the negative mirror of a gift that materially realizes commitment.
Active self-withdrawal supplies one side of the agency reversal.
Being placed at a distance supplies the protected counterpart to self-directed withdrawal.
Repelling harm through protection supplies the result of the contrasting orientation.
Giving supplies outward transfer instead of self-enclosure.
Possessed wealth supplies the same material that can either circulate or be treated as insulation.
Growth through the transfer supplies an expanding rather than closed economy.
Purification supplies an inward transformation coupled to outward giving.

structural_cues: Two nearby ٱلَّذِى clauses identify opposed agents by compact verb sequences.
Active تَوَلَّىٰ is answered by passive يُجَنَّبُهَا, reversing who performs the distancing and what is distanced from.
Wealth that failed to protect in the negative path is deliberately transferred in the positive path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored relative clauses, active withdrawal, passive distancing, protection, giving, wealth, and growth; I infer an inversion of agency and circulation. A live alternative is that the portraits contrast outcomes without making the later giving sequence part of the focus verb's mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus subject is simply the negative person who turns away.
changed_reading.after: He is the inverse of the giving subject: he turns himself away from truth and remains exposed, while the other sends wealth outward and is turned away from danger.

context_deltas.mechanism: The absence of a repayable favor cancels horizontal debt, while seeking a face, lordly formation, and height establishes a vertical orientation. This makes focus withdrawal relationally thick: denial falsifies the source of good, and turning away redirects face and allegiance toward a lower exchange economy.

activation_trace.role: False attribution supplies misrecognition of the claim or source to which response is due.
Turning face and attention supplies the focus subject's capacity for redirected orientation.
Alliance and support supply the social attachment implicated by directional turning.
Exhaustive negation removes every human creditor from the motive structure.
Nearness and presence locate the supposed social account with another person.
A favorable condition or benefit supplies the debt that is explicitly denied.
Reciprocating an act supplies the horizontal exchange motive being excluded.
Seeking an object supplies the active vector of the alternative orientation.
Direction and destination supply the axis along which face and purpose are set.
Lordship and ownership supply the higher relation that displaces human credit.
Nurturing and bringing to completion supply a non-transactional source of formation.
Elevation and honor supply the vertical terminus of the quest.

structural_cues: The negated human favor and recompense are followed by an exception naming the sole quest.
The face image downstream answers the focus root's facing-and-averting polarity.
The giver's motive is detached from reciprocal social accounting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies canceled human debt, recompense, seeking, direction, lordship, nurture, and elevation; I infer that focus withdrawal redirects face and allegiance into a rival exchange economy and misrecognizes the source of good. A live alternative is that the positive agent's motive does not license any claim about the denier's substitute motive.

changed_reading.before: Turning away is spatial or attentional retreat.
changed_reading.after: Turning away is a transfer of face and allegiance: the subject rejects the higher source-relation and becomes available to lower calculations of possession, credit, and return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final image of acceptance reveals the affective opposite of the focus. Declaring false is refusal to accept what addresses one, and turning away closes the relation before mutual satisfaction can form.

activation_trace.role: Declaring false supplies an adjudicative rejection rather than receptive assent.
Facing, following, or accepting supplies the unrealized receptive pole within the focus root.
Averting supplies the actual closure against that receptive pole.
Acceptance opposed to displeasure supplies the final affective state missing from denial.
Mutual satisfaction supplies a relational completion that withdrawal prevents.

structural_cues: The emphatic future satisfaction closes the same sequence that identifies the denying, withdrawing subject.
Both denial and satisfaction are evaluative responses, but one breaks relation while the other completes it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies acceptance, possible mutual satisfaction, false attribution, and aversion; I infer an affective axis from rejection-and-closure to reception-and-completion. A live alternative is that the final satisfaction belongs only to the positive agent and should not be treated as a semantic opposite of focus denial.

changed_reading.before: Denial is an intellectual error and turning away is its behavioral sequel.
changed_reading.after: The pair is also affective closure: the subject refuses reception and exits the relation that could culminate in acceptance and satisfaction.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates pastoral and produce-state branches that are form-distant from the focus verbs. It remains anchored in both focus roots and is sharpened by the packet's wealth, sufficiency, and growth sequence. Downstream prose should mark it as a material analogy for failed durability, not substitute milk or drying dates for the ordinary verbal senses.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus roots contain images of expected milk failing to last and ripe dates beginning to dry or change state.

activation_trace.role: A yield that disappears instead of lasting supplies denial as failed material promise.
Ripeness tipping into drying or color change supplies withdrawal as a transition out of living yield.
Sufficiency supplies the expectation that the stored yield will be enough.
Accumulated wealth supplies the stock whose durability is trusted.
Growth supplies the live counter-process to depletion and arrested circulation.

changed_reading.before: The subject verbally denies and then turns away.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, his denial is a yield that fails its promise and his turning is ripeness tipping into desiccation; withheld wealth does not grow because circulation has been arrested.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the race-follower branch of the fire-contact root rather than its surface fire sense. It remains anchored through the focus root's succession image and the context's purposeful and facilitated motion. Render it only as a trajectory analogy: turning away does not remove the subject from procession.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's تَوَلَّىٰ root contains continuous succession, allowing retreat to be recast as taking a place in an onward sequence.

activation_trace.role: A charge tested by whether it carries through supplies the criterion for the whole course.
Unbroken succession supplies the procession that continues after apparent retreat.
Purposeful movement supplies directed participation rather than accidental drift.
Light, compliant motion supplies the ease with which the procession continues.
The non-dominant mapped branch of following the race-leader supplies a positional image immediately beside the fire sense.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, turning away fixes the subject as a follower in a facilitated procession: he leaves the address but not the course whose next stage is contact with fire.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines the focus root's legal-social patronage branch with the non-dominant cutting branch mapped from recompense. It remains anchored in تَوَلَّىٰ and in the explicit context of favor and repayment. Downstream prose should present it as a legal-social analogy for severed obligation and keep the split-root cut distinct from the dominant recompense reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's second root can name patronage, kinship, neighborhood, and affiliated dependence as well as withdrawal.

activation_trace.role: Falsehood in action supplies breach of the relation's claimed terms.
Patronage and affiliated dependence supply the bond from which withdrawal can secede.
Exhaustive negation clears the positive giver of every human creditor.
Benefit supplies the favor around which social obligation would normally form.
Repayment supplies the dominant exchange relation explicitly denied as motive.
The non-dominant mapped image of cutting supplies a contained analogy for severing the bond itself.

changed_reading.before: The subject turns away from a message as an individual act.
changed_reading.after: As a contained legal-social reading, he falsifies and severs a bond of allegiance or obligation, unlike the giver whose act is free of human debt and repayment.

strongest_changes: Denial shifted from a merely propositional error to failed enactment within opposed giving, guarding, withholding, and self-sufficiency circuits.
Turning away shifted from passive disengagement to purposeful reorientation whose chosen distance can reverse into contact with what was warned.
The mirrored relative clauses made agency decisive: one subject turns himself away from truth, while the giving subject is turned away from danger.
The first-last and return-to-outcome branches kept a coexisting temporal reading in which apparent exit enters an unbroken consequential sequence.
summary.what_was_special: The packet activated the focus as a compact causal hinge rather than a two-item vice list. Direction, circulation, visibility, temporal return, social debt, and affective acceptance coexist without requiring one final disambiguation; split mappings and material branches added live but explicitly contained readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The context may characterize opposed persons without semantically redefining the focus verbs as strongly as the performative and circulation models propose.

The polarity inside و ل ي remains productive but unstable: withdrawal is surface-near, while facing, succession, charge, alliance, and patronage may be mechanism-level echoes rather than direct senses here.
The failed-yield, race-procession, and severed-patronage outliers should remain analogical unless additional evidence independently strengthens their branch-distant moves.
Non-dominant mapped roots preserve genuine activation possibilities, but their contribution may reflect lexical resonance rather than the intended morphology of the source word.
